verdict.rationale: Brevo documents a broad first-party API: contact management, transactional email/SMS/WhatsApp, ecommerce sync, programmatic conversations, event tracking, loyalty program creation and an MCP integration. That covers much of the platform programmatically. However, nothing states that the API matches the UI, and several UI features have no documented API equivalent. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim, documented API coverage for UI features such as the drag-and-drop editor, landing pages, forms, A/B testing, segments, multi-step automation workflows and Aura AI, and independent corroboration of coverage depth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Import, update, and organize your contact lists programmatically.
Integrate live chat widgets and manage conversations programmatically.
Learn how to create, configure, and publish a loyalty program via the Brevo API.
Enable AI models to interact with your Brevo account through standardized endpoints.
